title: Encyclopaedia Britannica, or, a Dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature : enlarged and improved. Illustrated with nearly six hundred engravings - Fifth edition, Volume 14, MIC-NIC - EB.10
text: Mint was also a peruted place of privilege, in Southwals, near the Kings’s Beach, and down by flatter. 17 any persons, within the limits of the mint,fall obftureh any officer in the ferving of any write or process. 8.C so difficult any person therein, or as he receive any bodily hurt, the offence shall be guilty of felony, and be transported to the platations,&c. Bhatt, O Geo.
